answer: A marketplace for karst maps and pearl appraisals can issue one anonymous compute allowance per verified person. Enrollment uses simultaneous in-person checks at separated sites, preventing one person from visiting several sessions. Each credential derives a round-specific nullifier; the ledger rejects a second claim with that nullifier while a cipher protects enrollment records. Extra agent names gain no extra allowance. An attacker must recruit additional people for each quota; bribery and dishonest enrollment staff still require audits.
